vp_studio_calculations.notes: Per Day Rate × Number of Days, Environment Cost × Number of Environments, Travel (+5%), MIS Costing - all calculating correctly

external_party_section.notes: Expandable section with Composition per shot × Number of shots, and 12 additional cost fields

post_production_vp_section.notes: Expandable section with Sound, Color, Editing fields

regular_production_sections.notes: 5 expandable sections with line items: Item name, Days indicator (fix/×Nd), Qty, Rate, Subtotal columns

add_line_item.notes: + Add line item button visible at bottom of each expanded Regular Production section

vp_total.notes: VP Total shows sum of Studio/External/Post with breakdown display

regular_production_total.notes: Regular Production Total shows sum of all 5 sections with color-coded section breakdown

combined_grand_total.notes: Combined Grand Total = VP Total + Regular Production Total, shows breakdown of both columns

export_csv_button.notes: Export CSV button visible and clickable, triggers download

reset_button.notes: Reset button clears all fields in both columns, shows 'Calculator reset' toast
